note: Every `stated` text is a verbatim fragment of the entry's `request_text`; the reading is that fragment's place in the commission. The measurement asks whether the canonical intent record can CARRY each stated instruction in the slot its facet names - not whether this reading is the only one a reader could make.

facets.goal: what the commission wants to be true
facets.inferred_goal: a goal Ren read out of the commission rather than being told

facets.explicit_constraint: what the requester bound the change by
facets.preservation: what must not change while the change happens
facets.accepted_autonomy: the latitude the requester granted, in their words
